chapters.label: The save, live
chapters.text: Wembley, the Euro 2020 final. Penalties! Italy lead England three-two. Bukayo Saka, just nineteen, bravely steps up. Gianluigi Donnarumma waits on his line... Saka shoots. Donnarumma dives left. Saved! Italy are champions!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Donnarumma stays big and still. He waits for the kick. Then he springs, and stops the ball.

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: what a save! All of Italy runs to him!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, stay big and wait. Don't dive too early. Watch the kick, then spring! And kickers: be brave, like Saka.
